superawesomecraft.durability.broken: Broken: repair it in a crafting grid with its material
superawesomecraft.enchanting.hint: Put a tool, weapon or armour piece in the slot on the left.
superawesomecraft.enchanting.apply_book_: Puts the book's enchantments on the item for free. They still use slots.
superawesomecraft.enchanting.select: Pick an enchantment from the list, then put its materials in the slots below.
superawesomecraft.enchanting.upgrade_det: Adds one slot to this item. Each upgrade works once per item.
superawesomecraft.enchanting.upgrade_don: This item already has this slot.
superawesomecraft.enchanting.desc.minecr: Mines faster: +1, +4, +9, +16, +26 mining speed.
Lasts longer: each use has a 1 in (level + 1) chance to cost durability.
Blocks drop themselves: ores, glass, grass and more.
More drops from ores and crops: up to +1, +2 or +3 extra.
Mobs drop up to 1 more item per level, and rare drops are likelier.
Better fishing: more treasure, less junk.
Fish bite faster: 5 seconds sooner per level.
+1 damage at I, then +0.5 per level (+3 at V).
+2.5 damage per level against undead mobs.
+2.5 damage per level against spiders, bees, silverfish and endermites, and slows them.
Knocks mobs back 3 more blocks per level.
Sets the target on fire for 4 seconds per level.
Sweep attacks deal 50%, 67% or 75% of the hit's damage.
Ignores 15% of the target's armour per level.
Mace smash attacks deal +0.5 damage per block fallen, per level.
A mace smash launches you back up into the air.
Spear jabs launch you forward. Costs hunger.
Arrows deal +25% damage per level, plus 25%.
Arrows knock mobs back 3 blocks per level.
Arrows set targets on fire for 5 seconds.
Shooting doesn't use normal arrows. You still need one.
Fires 3 arrows for the price of one.
Arrows pass through 1 more mob per level.
Loads the crossbow 0.25 seconds faster per level.
+2.5 damage per level against sea creatures.
A thrown trident flies back to you. Higher levels return faster.
Throwing the trident in water or rain launches you with it.
In a thunderstorm, a trident hit calls down lightning.
Reduces most damage by 4% per level, per piece.
Reduces explosion damage by 8% per level, per piece, and cuts knockback.
Reduces fire damage by 8% per level, per piece, and shortens burning.
Reduces arrow and projectile damage by 8% per level, per piece.
Reduces fall damage by 12% per level.
15% chance per level to hurt attackers for 1 to 4 damage.
Breathe 15 seconds longer underwater per level.
Mine at normal speed underwater.
Walk faster underwater: one third faster per level.
Water freezes into ice under your feet as you walk.
Walk faster on soul sand and soul soil.
Sneak 15% faster per level.
Can't be taken off once worn, except by dying.
Disappears when you die.
superawesomecraft.enchanting.desc.supera: Digs a 3x3 around the face you hit, a bit slower. Only on blocks the tool is good at. Crouch for one block.
Cuts down the whole tree, up to 192 logs. Each log costs durability. Crouch for one log.
Mined blocks drop already smelted: sand to glass, raw iron to ingots.
10% chance per level for a kill to drop the mob's head.
Break and place blocks 1 block further away per level. Doesn't help in fights.
Walk up full blocks without jumping.
+2.5 damage per level against pillagers, vindicators, evokers and other illagers.
Slows the target for 3 seconds, +2 per level. Can't go with Fire Aspect.
Knocks melee attackers away from you. Stronger each level.
Holding the shield resists 50% knockback per level.
